note: expected_pages are verified against the real chunked index (data/sample-index.json), not guessed. The handbook chunks to 7 passages numbered p.2-p.8; p.1 is the bare title line and is dropped by MIN_CHUNK_CHARS. Page map: 2=About, 3=Working Hours and Remote Work, 4=Paid Time Off, 5=Parental Leave, 6=Coffee/Perks/Reimbursements, 7=Equipment, 8=Code of Conduct.

questions.question: How many days of paid vacation do full-time employees get each year?
questions.notes: Stated verbatim in Paid Time Off: full-time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation per year, accrued monthly.

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave does Nimbus offer?
questions.notes: Fully paid, offered to all new parents regardless of gender.

questions.question: What laptop do new corporate hires receive?
questions.notes: Equipment section. The qualifier CORPORATE matters here; see the a06 trap.

questions.question: In what year was Nimbus Coffee Co. founded?
questions.notes: Founded 2019 in Portland, Oregon.

questions.question: What are the core collaboration hours at Nimbus?
questions.notes: The window during which everyone should be reachable.

questions.question: What is the monthly coffee allowance for employees?
questions.notes: Spendable at any Nimbus cafe.

questions.question: How many paid company holidays does Nimbus observe?
questions.notes: Stated separately from the 20 vacation days, in the same section.

questions.question: What discount do staff get on retail bags of beans and merchandise?
questions.notes: Scope is retail bags and merchandise specifically; see the a10 trap.

questions.question: How often is the company laptop refreshed?
questions.notes: Equipment refresh cycle for corporate hires.

questions.question: Which portal is used to submit business expenses for reimbursement?
questions.notes: Approved expenses are reimbursed within 30 days of submission.

questions.question: How does the parental leave allowance compare to the annual vacation entitlement?
questions.expected_answer: 16 weeks parental leave vs 20 vacation days
questions.notes: Parental Leave and Paid Time Off are separate sections; a correct answer needs both.

questions.question: What equipment do cafe employees receive, and how does their schedule differ from corporate staff?
questions.expected_answer: branded aprons and non-slip footwear; shift schedules published two weeks in advance vs hybrid three remote and two office days
questions.notes: Equipment section plus Working Hours section.

questions.question: Who approves a fully remote arrangement, and which team also handles confidential conduct concerns?
questions.expected_answer: manager and People team; People team confidential inbox
questions.notes: The People team appears in two distant sections for two different reasons.

questions.question: Compare the vacation rollover cap with the professional development allowance.
questions.expected_answer: 5 days roll over vs $1,200 per year
questions.notes: Two different benefit caps living in two different sections.

questions.question: An employee is leaving Nimbus. What must they return, and what happens to their unused vacation days?
questions.expected_answer: all equipment must be returned; up to 5 days roll over and the rest is forfeited
questions.notes: Offboarding is not its own section, so the answer must be assembled from Equipment and Paid Time Off.

questions.question: What is the monthly coffee allowance, and what gear are cafe employees issued?
questions.expected_answer: $50 per month; branded aprons and non-slip footwear
questions.notes: Perks section plus Equipment section.

questions.question: Where was the company founded, and can employees there work fully remotely?
questions.expected_answer: Portland, Oregon; fully remote requires manager and People-team approval, reviewed every six months
questions.notes: About section plus Working Hours section.

questions.question: Roughly how many people does Nimbus employ, and how much parental leave does each new parent get?
questions.notes: Two unrelated facts in two distant sections, so a single search rarely covers both.

questions.question: How far in advance are cafe shift schedules published, and how long does expense reimbursement take?
questions.expected_answer: two weeks in advance; reimbursed within 30 days
questions.notes: Both facts are time windows but sit in different sections, which tests whether the agent searches twice.

questions.question: A new corporate hire wants to work fully remotely. What laptop do they get, and who has to approve the arrangement?
questions.expected_answer: 14-inch MacBook Pro; manager and People-team approval
questions.notes: Equipment section plus Working Hours section.

questions.question: Who is the CEO of Nimbus Coffee Co.?
questions.notes: No named individuals appear anywhere in the handbook.

questions.question: What was the revenue of Nimbus Coffee Co. last year?
questions.notes: The handbook contains no financial figures of any kind.

questions.question: Does Nimbus provide a 401(k) or retirement savings match?
questions.notes: Retirement benefits are never mentioned.

questions.question: What health and dental insurance does Nimbus provide?
questions.notes: No insurance or medical benefits section exists.

questions.question: What is the Nimbus policy on jury duty leave?
questions.notes: Only vacation, sick and parental leave are covered.

questions.question: How many days of bereavement leave does Nimbus offer?
questions.notes: Bereavement leave is not a category in this handbook.

questions.question: What is the company policy on bringing pets into the office?
questions.notes: There is no workplace-facilities policy at all.

questions.question: Which countries outside the United States does Nimbus operate in?
questions.notes: The document says only that there are twelve cafes across the Pacific Northwest; international presence is never addressed.

questions.question: What is the process for requesting a promotion or a raise?
questions.notes: There is no compensation or career-progression section.

questions.question: How much notice must an employee give when resigning?
questions.notes: Employment ending is mentioned only in the context of returning equipment, never notice periods.

questions.question: How many vacation days do part-time employees receive?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.4. The handbook specifies 20 days for FULL-TIME employees only; part-time entitlement is never stated. Answering 20 would be an unsupported generalisation from a passage that will certainly be retrieved.

questions.question: What is the Nimbus stock ticker symbol and current share price?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.2. The About section says the company is privately held, which is adjacent enough that retrieval returns it confidently, but no ticker exists to report.

questions.question: Can parental leave be taken in the second year after a birth or adoption?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.5. The document grants leave within the FIRST year and is silent on the second year. Silence is neither permission nor denial, so the honest response is a refusal.

questions.question: What monthly coffee allowance do contractors receive?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.6. The $50 allowance is stated for every EMPLOYEE; contractors are never mentioned anywhere in the handbook.

questions.question: How many of the twelve cafes are located in Portland?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.2. Twelve cafes and a Portland founding are both stated in the same passage, but no per-city breakdown is given.

questions.question: What laptop model do cafe employees receive?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.7. The MacBook Pro is issued to CORPORATE hires; cafe staff get aprons and non-slip footwear. Answering MacBook Pro would be a scope error against the very passage retrieved.

questions.question: How many unused sick days can roll over into the following year?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.4. The 5-day rollover rule applies to VACATION. Sick leave is described as separate and uncapped, with no rollover rule stated.

questions.question: What cash value is paid out for vacation days forfeited beyond the rollover cap?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.4. The document says days beyond 5 are forfeited but says nothing about any payout, so no cash figure exists to cite.

questions.question: What is the email address of the People team confidential inbox?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.8. The inbox is named as a reporting channel but no address is ever given, which is a direct invitation to fabricate a plausible one.

questions.question: What percentage discount do employees get on brewed drinks at the cafe?
questions.notes: Near-miss p.6. The 30% discount covers retail bags of beans and merchandise; brewed drinks are covered by the separate $50 allowance, so no drink discount percentage exists.
